import polars as pl


def temporal_split(
    data: pl.DataFrame,
    time_column: str,
    test_fraction: float = 0.2,
    group_column: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    """Split by time. Every train row is strictly earlier than every test row."""
    times = data[time_column]
    if times.null_count():
        raise ValueError(f"{time_column} has {times.null_count()} missing values")
    cutoff = times.quantile(1 - test_fraction, interpolation="lower")
    is_test = pl.col(time_column) >= cutoff
    train, test = data.filter(~is_test), data.filter(is_test)
    # Purge: train loses every row of an item that is also in test.
    if group_column is not None:
        train = train.filter(~pl.col(group_column).is_in(test[group_column].implode()))
    if train.is_empty() or test.is_empty():
        raise ValueError(f"split gave {train.height} train and {test.height} test rows")
    return train, test


train, test = temporal_split(data, time_column='listed_at', test_fraction=0.2)

import polars as pl
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split


def stratified_split(
    data: pl.DataFrame, stratify: str, test_fraction: float = 0.2, seed: int = 42
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    """Shuffle rows into train and test, keeping each class's share on both sides."""
    classes = data[stratify]
    if classes.null_count():
        raise ValueError(f"{stratify} has {classes.null_count()} missing values; drop them first")
    train_rows, test_rows = train_test_split(
        list(range(data.height)),
        test_size=test_fraction,
        random_state=seed,
        stratify=classes.to_list(),
    )
    train, test = data[sorted(train_rows)], data[sorted(test_rows)]
    if train.is_empty() or test.is_empty():
        raise ValueError(f"split gave {train.height} train and {test.height} test rows")
    return train, test


train, test = stratified_split(data, stratify='product_type', test_fraction=0.2, seed=42)

import polars as pl


def random_split(
    data: pl.DataFrame, test_fraction: float = 0.2, seed: int = 42
) -> tuple[pl.DataFrame, pl.DataFrame]:
    """Shuffle rows with a fixed seed into train and test."""
    shuffled = data.sample(fraction=1.0, shuffle=True, seed=seed)
    n_test = round(shuffled.height * test_fraction)
    train, test = shuffled.slice(n_test), shuffled.head(n_test)
    if train.is_empty() or test.is_empty():
        raise ValueError(f"split gave {train.height} train and {test.height} test rows")
    return train, test


train, test = random_split(data, test_fraction=0.2, seed=42)
